messages:
tia: FYI noticed a batch of service accounts went inactive after nightly KMS rewrap. SCIM responses from Okta returned 204 but our audit entries lack envelope-id. should we treat as P1? :grimacing:
nate: that's bad. which alias did the rewrap target? the new v2 alias?
maria: rewrap job used alias `redwood-prod-kms-v2` at 02:13 UTC. most tenants OK but I see decrypt errors in scim-provisioner right after the rewrap window. snippet from logs:
```
2026-03-22T02:14:36.123Z scim-provisioner ERROR tenant=acme decrypt failed err=\"missing envelope metadata\" svc=provisioner request_id=req_1a2b3c
2026-03-22T02:14:36.124Z scim-provisioner WARN tenant=acme fallback to noop-deprov
```

alex: can you paste a redacted SCIM deprovision payload for an affected svc account? want to check externalId/id and metadata behavior.
tia: example payload (redacted): {"schemas":["urn:ietf:params:scim:schemas:core:2.0:User"],"id":"svc-1234","userName":"svc-ci-agent","active":false}

ops-bot: deploy-bot: infra/release/2026.03.22 deployed to staging at 02:05 UTC :rocket:

maria: KMS audit shows the new envelope uses `env_version:2` and `env_meta` keys. our audit-joiner expects `env_id` at top-level. missing mapping meant audit joiner didn't annotate those deprov events with envelope-id, so downstream deprov logic treated as suspect and removed accounts.
nate: that fits. scope? only service accounts?
maria: grep shows 18 flagged events: 15 service accounts, 3 human user accounts (all non-prod). pattern: created before 2025-11 and never rewrapped before yesterday.
tia: immediate actions: 1) pause any further rewraps for redwood-prod-kms-v2 2) enable provisioner guard that requeues events missing envelope metadata 3) schedule a backfill to map env_version:2 -> env_id for affected time range 4) open Okta support if 4xx persists.
alex: I'll open an incident and assign owners. alex = incident lead, tia = backfill + okta case, nate = KMS rollback/compat.
idp-bot: ticket INF-2026-314 created: okta/scim deprovs after kms rewrap assigned to @alex.

maria: quick ELK fetch to pull failing event for repro:
```
curl -s "https://elk.internal/_search?q=request_id:req_1a2b3c&size=1" | jq '.hits.hits[0]._source'
```

nate: temporary mitigation (pseudo):
```
# if envelope-id missing, don't deprov, requeue
if event.kms.envelope_id == null then
  requeue_event(event)
else
  apply_deprov(event)
end
```

tia: I already flipped a short-lived feature flag on the provisioner at 02:50 UTC to requeue missing-envelope events. monitoring shows no new deprovs since.
maria: confirmed. added 30m watch and alerted SLO channel. once stable we'll run backfill.

alex: plan in INF-2026-314: postmortem owner = maria, timeline + RCA by EOD. @nate follow up with KMS team to ensure envelope format compatibility and add a nightly CI check.
nate: will add unit test that fails if unknown envelope formats appear without a mapping shim. also check rollover docs.
tia: opened Okta ticket OKTA-88921 describing partial 204s during deprov retries; attached logs.
maria: vuln triage note: no indicators of compromise; looks like a compatibility regression from rewrap. marking this operational incident not security.
alex: we'll keep INF-2026-314 open until backfill completes and audit joiner annotations verified for rewrap range. thanks everyone :pray:
